name: session-read
description: Claude Code sessions in a time window, each with its first human prompts, read from local transcripts. Never cached.

verbs.name: list
verbs.description: Sessions a person started in the window, oldest first, without machine sessions and forks. Prints one line per session, or the session list with --json.

days.description: Length of the window in days, counted back from --until or from now. 1 or more.

until.description: ISO date or datetime. Sessions starting after it are excluded. A date means the end of that day, and a time without an offset means UTC.

root.description: Folder holding one folder of transcripts per project.

maxPrompts.description: Most prompts kept per session. 1 or more.

maxChars.description: Most characters kept per prompt. 1 or more.
